name: Pietro Bordino
features: olive skin, dark hair, brown eyes, clean-shaven, athletic build, intense features, fierce expression
bio: Pietro Bordino was an Italian racing driver known as the 'Last of the Romans' for his daring style. He was one of Fiat's top drivers in the 1920s, winning multiple Grand Prix races. He died in a racing accident at Alessandria in 1928.
